attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kentucky corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false /result.ky_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions)

action_details.action_postfix: true /result.ky_has_nexus xdef "Kentucky filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)" job.audit_trail swap addto
true /result.ky_has_nexus xdef "Kentucky filing required: Economic nexus (exceeds $100,000 gross receipts or 200 transactions)" job.audit_trail swap addto
false /result.ky_has_nexus xdef 0.0 /result.ky_tax_liability xdef "Kentucky filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KY requires addback of federal interest income and IRC 199A deduction, with subtraction of KY municipal bond interest and dividends from KY corporations.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ky_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.ky_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ky_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.ky_state_subtractions xdef "Kentucky adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky corporate income tax. Applies Kentucky flat rate (4.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ky_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ky_tax_liability xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.ky_apportioned_income result.ky_state_additions add result.ky_state_subtractions sub 0.0 max /result.ky_taxable_income xdef
result.ky_taxable_income result.ky_corp_tax_rate mul /ky_tax_before_credits xdef
ky_tax_before_credits result.ky_state_credits sub 0.0 max /result.ky_tax_liability xdef
result.ky_estimated_payments result.ky_tax_liability sub /result.ky_refund_or_owed xdef
"Kentucky taxable income: $" result.ky_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kentucky tax liability (4.5%): $" result.ky_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ky_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ky_tax_liability xdef result.ky_estimated_payments /result.ky_refund_or_owed xdef "Kentucky tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ky_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ky_tax_liability xdef result.ky_estimated_payments /result.ky_refund_or_owed xdef "Kentucky tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
